# Newham Solutions Pte. Ltd.

> Newham works with construction businesses in Singapore and India in three ways: it builds the CCorex construction software suite, provides dedicated M&E engineering professionals (estimators, QS, BIM modellers, tender coordinators, fire protection engineers), and delivers scoped engineering services (fire protection design and hydraulic calculations, BOQ preparation and tender support).

## Services
- [BOQ preparation and M&E estimation services](https://newhamtech.com/boq-estimation-services): take-offs, priced BOQs, rate build-ups and tender queries for fire protection, ACMV, electrical, ELV and plumbing.
- [M&E engineering services](https://newhamtech.com/engineering-services): overview of Newham's fire protection design, estimation and BOQ, shop drawing and commercial support services.
- [Fire protection and sprinkler design](https://newhamtech.com/fire-protection-design): sprinkler design and hydraulic calculations to SS CP 52 (NFPA 13 where specified), fire alarm design to SS 645, formatted for SCDF submission.
- [MEP shop drawing and as-built drafting](https://newhamtech.com/shop-drawing-services): MEP shop drawings, coordination drawings and as-built drawings.
- [Engineering talent outsourcing](https://newhamtech.com/talent-outsourcing): dedicated M&E estimators, QS, BIM modellers and coordinators working in the client's templates.
- [CCorex software](https://ccorex.com): estimating, project cost control and HR & payroll for contractors.

## Guides
